description: Use before accepting any explanation for a connection-reset-style symptom: a WebSocket/SSE dropping at a suspiciously exact interval, intermittent "connection reset by peer"/ECONNRESET, a proxy/CDN/load-balancer symptom not matching the blamed layer, DB connection-pool exhaustion, or a job/queue/scheduler failing intermittently with no config change. Use the moment anyone — including yourself — proposes a fix on a guess: "just restart it," "just bump the pool size," "just add a retry," or a fix that "worked last time." Enforces evidence-first investigation: no theory without a concrete artifact (log line, packet capture, metric, stack trace) behind it, every hypothesis must name what would falsify it, isolate the cause through paths that differ by one hop at a time instead of stacking assumptions, and get a second opinion before committing to a root cause or shipping a fix. Also applies beyond networking — the same reset/exhaustion shape shows up in DB pools, thread pools, and job schedulers too.
